aeolus:
And slow ascending glided o'er the plain,
Till AEolus in his rapid chariot drove
In gloomy grandeur from the vault above:
aeons: Aeons upon aeons have passed since the first grey dawn made us visible to one another; and though we have seen the birth and the fullness and the death of many worlds, we are still eager and young.

Have you found me, at last, O my Dream?
Seven aeons ago
You died and I buried you deep under forests
aeolian: It was like the voice of a soul that had once lived in an Aeolian harp.
